item.description:
• The menu bar's Refine flyout no longer closes by itself. Background activity (like a model download ticking progress) was invalidating the open menu; the menu now redraws only when something it actually shows changes.
  • Quitting Amanu while a dictation's cleanup pass is still running no longer crashes on the way out. Quit now waits the fraction of a second it takes the language model to stop cleanly (bounded, so quit always stays fast).
  • New Glass appearance for the dictation HUD. Settings > General > Material now offers Ink (the classic warm near-black, still the default) or Glass: the capsule, notch bar, and floating orb render in real macOS Liquid Glass that adopts your desktop's color and light like the system widgets do (on macOS 26; earlier systems get a translucent material treatment). Switching applies instantly, mid-dictation included.
  • The waveform is smoother. Bars now move on a damped spring with a flowing, connected envelope instead of independent flicker, and the meter is denser with finer bars - speech reads as one liquid wave.
